Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute
right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and difficulty with overhead
reaching. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the crash,
and the clinical picture fits the type of trauma described. Over the course of care,
the patient completed 24 visits, consisting of physical therapy, range-of-motion and
strengthening exercises, and periodic re-evaluation. Treatment continued somewhat
longer than is typical for this presentation, largely to address persistent stiffness
and gradual functinoal gains. On examination, some findings, including limited active
elevation and tenderness over the rotator cuff region, support the reported injury,
while other tests, such as neurological screening and stability assessment, remained
within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to this
shoulder. Billing records reflect no duplicate or repeated charges for services.
Current status is improving, with ongoing home exercise and follow-up as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
